For nominal size D = 50 mm and a given geometric tolerance grade, the table gives tUm = 8 μm = 0.008 mm, so the notation is ⌖0.008. The higher the grade (the smaller the number), the tighter the tolerance.
map.：同一尺寸、公差值从 8 μm（较高精）到 25 μm（较低精），对应不同加工方: At the same size, tolerance values range from 8 μm (higher precision) to 25 μm (lower precision), matching different machining methods (grinding versus milling).
map.尺寸公差控制大小、形位公差控制形状/位置，二者独立（独立原则）或联动（最大实体要: Dimensional tolerance controls size while geometric tolerance controls form and position. The two are independent under the independency principle, or linked under the maximum material requirement.
map.公差值为什么用 μm？: Why are tolerance values given in μm?
map.精密件形位公差常为几至几十微米，用 μm 直观，标注时转 mm（÷1000）。: Geometric tolerances on precision parts are often a few to a few tens of micrometres, so μm is intuitive; convert to mm (÷1000) when writing the notation.
